Name: CHR_ACT_TURN_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the parameters used when a character turns.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Base - Turn Speed
Fields.Description: Standard turning speed for normal turning, the speed and time turning rate are applied to this value. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Base - Turn Speed Rate: Minimum Speed
Fields.Description: At or below this movement speed, the turn rate at minimum speed applies. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Base - Turn Speed Rate: Maximum Speed
Fields.Description: At or above this movement speed, the turn rate at maximum speed applies. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Base - Turn Speed Rate: % at Minimum Speed
Fields.Description: Speed turn rate applied at or below the minimum speed.

Fields.Name: Base - Turn Speed Rate: % at Maximum Speed
Fields.Description: Speed turn rate applied at or above the maximum speed.

Fields.Name: Base - Turn Time Rate: Minimum Time
Fields.Description: Up to this time after the parameter switches, the turn rate at minimum time applies. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Base - Turn Time Rate: Maximum Time
Fields.Description: From this time after the parameter switches onward, the turn rate at maximum time applies. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Base - Turn Time Rate: % at Minimum Time
Fields.Description: Time turn rate applied at or before the minimum time.

Fields.Name: Base - Turn Time Rate: % at Maximum Time
Fields.Description: Time turn rate applied at or after the maximum time.

Fields.Name: Look Target - Turn Speed
Fields.Description: Turning speed in the mode facing the target direction, reference turning speed is not used. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Look Target - Turn Speed with Low Delta
Fields.Description: Turning speed in the mode facing the target when the angle difference is small, the reference turning speed is not used. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Look Target - Low Delta Judgment Angle
Fields.Description: If the angle is smaller than this, the low delta angle speed will be used. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Look Target - Turn Speed Rate: Minimum Speed
Fields.Description: Look target mode. At or below this movement speed, the turn rate at minimum speed applies. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Look Target - Turn Speed Rate: Maximum Speed
Fields.Description: Look target mode. At or above this movement speed, the turn rate at maximum speed applies. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Look Target - Turn Speed Rate: % at Minimum Speed
Fields.Description: Look target mode. Speed turn rate applied at or below the minimum speed.

Fields.Name: Look Target - Turn Speed Rate: % at Maximum Speed
Fields.Description: Look target mode. Speed turn rate applied at or above the maximum speed.

Fields.Name: Look Target - Turn Time Rate: Minimum Time
Fields.Description: Look target mode. Up to this time after the parameter switches, the turn rate at minimum time applies. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Look Target - Turn Time Rate: Maximum Time
Fields.Description: Look target mode. From this time after the parameter switches onward, the turn rate at maximum time applies. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Look Target - Turn Time Rate: % at Minimum Time
Fields.Description: Look target mode. Time turn rate applied at or before the minimum time.

Fields.Name: Look Target - Turn Time Rate: % at Maximum Time
Fields.Description: Look target mode. Time turn rate applied at or after the maximum time.

Fields.Name: Turn Acceleration
Fields.Description: Angular acceleration used to reach the turn speed. Set a large value to turn at full speed from the start. In degrees per second squared.

Fields.Name: Look Target - Look Ahead Time
Fields.Description: When turning to face the target, the character aims at where the target will be this many seconds later. Used by AI. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Base - Time Turn Acceleration Rate: Minimum Time
Fields.Description: Up to this time after the parameter switches, the angular acceleration rate at minimum time applies. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Base - Time Turn Acceleration Rate: Maximum Time
Fields.Description: From this time after the parameter switches onward, the angular acceleration rate at maximum time applies. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Base - Time Turn Acceleration Rate: Minimum Acceleration Rate
Fields.Description: Angular acceleration rate applied at or before the minimum time.

Fields.Name: Base - Time Turn Acceleration Rate: Maximum Acceleration Rate
Fields.Description: Angular acceleration rate applied at or after the maximum time.

Fields.Name: Look Target - Time Turn Acceleration Rate: Minimum Time
Fields.Description: Look target mode. Up to this time after the parameter switches, the angular acceleration rate at minimum time applies. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Look Target - Time Turn Acceleration Rate: Maximum Time
Fields.Description: Look target mode. From this time after the parameter switches onward, the angular acceleration rate at maximum time applies. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Look Target - Time Turn Acceleration Rate: Minimum Acceleration Rate
Fields.Description: Look target mode. Angular acceleration rate applied at or before the minimum time.

Fields.Name: Look Target - Time Turn Acceleration Rate: Maximum Acceleration Rate
Fields.Description: Look target mode. Angular acceleration rate applied at or after the maximum time.

Fields.Name: Angular Acceleration Interpolation Time at Parameter End
Fields.Description: Time to interpolate acceleration when parameters switch and exit. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Reverse Turn Brake Performance
Fields.Description: Brake applied when turning in the opposite direction. -1: disabled. In degrees per second squared.

Fields.Name: Angular Velocity for Left/Right Blend Ratio
Fields.Description: When the angular velocity exceeds this speed, the blend ratio of left and right animation becomes 1. In degrees per second.
